Failure modes arise from mismatches in agent readiness, workflow classification, or assessment integrity. The system enforces a hierarchy of trust through approval layers, ensuring that only vetted agents and workflows interact with critical components such as publishing or model weight changes. This design reflects a robust control-theoretic framework balancing autonomy with oversight.
